description: 국토교통부_재난상황정보 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 침수, 하천 범람, 땅꺼짐, 화재 등 다양한 재난 유형)과 세부 이벤트 정보를 포함하며, 경위도 기반의 위치 정보와 도로명, 차단 통제 유형(전면통제, 부분통제 등) 및 차단 차로. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 재난상황정보, 지하차도침수, 하천범람홍수, 지반침하, 산불정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
